sql: SELECT placement,ad_group,uniqExact(tuple(openid,impression_id)) ads,uniqExact(openid) users FROM ad_events_v2 FINAL WHERE appid='wx85d24d5dbf72b423' AND occurred_at>='2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND occurred_at<'2026-11-16 11:00:00' AND event_type='completed' AND ingest_verified=1 AND impression_id!=''  AND hex(SHA256(openid)) NOT IN ('2C111186BF7A563FD38435C153E609C64BDA13230050212ED9E8BCCF2EC96602') GROUP BY placement,ad_group LIMIT 10000
